Care for you, and for the people you care for

One practice for your own checkups and for an aging parent's care, so nothing falls through the cracks.

Adults and families

  • Annual physicals and preventive screenings
  • Diabetes, blood pressure, cholesterol and thyroid care
  • Visits when you're feeling sick
  • Women's health exams, including Pap tests
  • Allergy and arthritis care
  • In-office blood work and urine tests
See all services

Seniors and their families

  • Memory concerns and dementia evaluation
  • Bone health and osteoporosis
  • Bladder control and incontinence
  • Managing several conditions and medications together
  • Planning ahead for future care
  • Medicare and Medicare plans accepted
Learn about senior care

Becoming a new patient

Four simple steps, and our front desk helps with each one.

  1. Check your insurance

    Look for your plan on our insurance page, or ask us when we call.

  2. Request a time

    Use the online form any time, or call during office hours.

  3. We call to confirm

    Our front desk calls you back to set the day and time.

  4. Come to your first visit

    Bring your photo ID, insurance card and a list of your medications.
